Subject: Evaluation Kickoff: Acme Corp — Next Steps & Scheduling

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the evaluation kicked off smoothly: 

- Goal: run a 2-week evaluation focused on (1) retrieval-augmented generation for internal knowledge, and (2) a short form summarization pipeline for support tickets.
- Success criteria (draft): 90%+ fidelity on relevant doc retrieval, 20% reduction in average ticket triage time, and stable p50 latency < 350ms for demo requests. Please flag any edits.
- Proposed next meeting: Evaluation kickoff (trial plan + prompt-set review + success criteria alignment) — 60 min. We’ll bring a solutions engineer to cover architecture and a PM to review success metrics.

I’m available Mon/Tue next week: Jan 19 (10–12 CT) or Jan 20 (14–16 CT). Connor, Marissa — can you join any of those windows for a short technical deep-dive?

Attached: redwood-eval-plan.pdf (high-level trial plan + roles/responsibilities).

If those times don’t work, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll align. Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
